rubric_items.reason: All 11 known REQs are traced. S-1 covers REQ-1-4, 9 and 10, S-2 covers REQ-5-7, S-3 covers REQ-11 and S-4 covers REQ-8. The intent has no assumed REQs.
Each story is small. S-2 joins three exclusion rules with the empty state, but they all describe one outcome: what shows when there is no valid next appointment.

The ACs are Given/When/Then and mostly discriminating. The time-zone ACs use instants whose local and UTC dates differ, and the booking-order AC catches first-booked logic. No AC covers a start time exactly equal to now.
Every UTC instant is derived inline from Asia/Kolkata = UTC+05:30, and the conversions are correct. The other dates and times are test data, not invented limits.
Terms are consistent and clear. The body summaries of the ACs are shorter than the YAML versions and slightly change S-2 AC2's Given.
